senses.gloss: שַׁפֵּיץ (Shaf. of פצץ) [to undo a breach (cmp. דִּשֵּׁן to remove the ashes),] to repair.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 11:11">Targ. II Chr. XI, 11</cite> <he>וש׳ ותקיף</he> (h. text <he>ויחזק</he>).

<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 11:23">Ib. 23</cite> <he>ובנא וש׳ קרוין ומני וכ׳</he> (h. text <he>ויבן ויפרץ</he>, to which Targ. supplies <he>ויפקד</he>) he built and fortified cities, and appointed &c.—
<cite ref="Megillah 4a:3">Meg. 4ᵃ</cite> <he>אתא אסא שַׁפְּצִינְהוּ</he> Ar. a. Rashi (ed. <he>שפצנהי</he>, corr. acc.) Asa came and restored their fortifications.
<cite ref="Yevamot 63a:10">Yeb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>טום ולא תְשַׁפֵּיץ שַׁפֵּיץ וכ׳</he> fill up (a hole in time), that thou need not repair, repair, that thou need not build.
